beans.name: 430 Colombia La Mina
beans.description: The bag states its process as "Double Anaerobic Honey": an anaerobic fermentation followed by honey drying. Both parts are stated, so both are carried; the array is the set of processes this coffee underwent, not an ordering of them.

beans.name: Zip Zinger
beans.description: The roaster states "Process / Washed, Natural" for a three-origin blend without saying which component takes which. The bag-level set is exactly that claim; the items stay silent rather than inventing the assignment.

beans.name: Jaguar Espresso
beans.description: Wet-hulled — giling basah — is the standard post-harvest method across Sumatra, and the roaster labels it "Milling: Wet Hulled".
